in_arabic.name: حميدة
in_arabic.long_meaning: The one who is constantly praised and admired by Allah and His Messenger (peace be upon him).

in_urdu.name: Hameedah
in_urdu.meaning: اسلامی نام جس کا مطلب ہے Praised, Grateful
in_urdu.long_meaning: Hameedah ایک اسلامی نام ہے جو مسلم ثقافت میں گہری روحانی اہمیت رکھتا ہے۔ A name derived from the Arabic word ‘Hameed’, meaning ‘to praise’ or ‘to give thanks’. In Islamic tradition, Hameedah signifies a woman who is constantly in the state of gratitude to Allah for His blessings.
